description: This Java class is a command handler for creating loan reschedule requests within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands of type RESCHEDULELOAN with the action CREATE, and delegates the creation logic to the LoanRescheduleRequestWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateLoanRescheduleRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles create commands for loan reschedule requests. It processes commands annotated with RESCHEDULELOAN and CREATE, and delegates to a service layer for actual creation logic.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a loan reschedule request by delegating to the service layer.
